description: Land Acquisition - Pannipitiya, Arawwala, Kottawa, Maharagama and Kesbewa D/S Division, Colombo District - Gangodawila, Navinna, Boralesgamuwa and Maharagama D/S Division, Colombo District
categorisation: This gazette content is exclusively about land acquisition notices under the Land Acquisition Act, detailing specific land parcels being acquired by the government for public purposes. It contains descriptions of individual land lots, their assessment numbers, types (garden, road), extents, and claimants. This falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) as it deals with land acquisitions and property matters.
